gen-gf-artifika-fs-bespoke-sans: Traditional and bookish, Artifika leans on gently loose spacing. Bespoke Sans, a sharp sans-serif with generous gaps where curves meet stems, would read crisply and refined down a full page of text.
gen-gf-arya-fs-literata: Approachable Arya keeps its strokes gently tempered, with only mild modulation. Literata follows with sturdy thin lines and open curved letters, giving the headings a bookish, sophisticated partner underneath.
gen-gf-asar-fs-bespoke-sans: Dignified, with none of the drama: Asar's contrast stays mild. Bespoke Sans takes over quietly further below, sharp and refined, with generous space where its curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-asta-sans-fs-literata: Literata reads bookish and sophisticated, its thinnest curves still carrying real weight. Asta Sans leads with a constant, neon-tube line and a gaping c, which gives the text serif beneath something to push against.
gen-gf-asul-fs-bespoke-sans: Asul has an editorial, authoritative look, its joins tapering modestly while curve tops tighten just slightly. Asul does the commanding; Bespoke Sans, a sans-serif, does the refined spacing.
gen-gf-average-fs-bespoke-sans: Stems barely heavier than their arms give Average its quiet, bookish look. Bespoke Sans brings the pair's sharpest quality: refined sans-serif letters with generous room where curves meet the stem.
gen-gf-average-sans-fs-literata: Literata brings sophisticated, bookish curves, with sturdy thin lines and a soft difference between fat and slim strokes. Average Sans, snug and approachable, leads in with tightly fitted letters.
gen-gf-b612-fs-literata: B612 is plain and professional, built for clarity without fuss. Literata adds bookish sophistication with sturdy thin lines and open curved letters, a noticeably warmer voice than the heading.
gen-gf-b612-mono-fs-literata: Technical and precise: B612 Mono sets fixed-width, code-style letters in open, extended tracking. Literata then adds a bookish serif voice with sturdy thin lines and curves that stay open.
gen-gf-bacasime-antique-fs-bespoke-sans: Jammed-together and dignified, Bacasime Antique pairs bold uprights with hairline-thin horizontals. But Bespoke Sans, sharp and refined, gives curves generous room, and that spaciousness is the pair's best quality.
